title: Player Out of Bounds Void Fall Without Death
explanation: At frame 826, player exceeded boundary (OUT_OF_BOUNDS_Y = 1400.0) reaching Y=1431.17, triggering player_out_of_bounds anomaly. In Player.gd:L214-L223 (_physics_process), the anomaly is logged but die() is never invoked, causing the player to fall continuously across window w03 from Y=1472.01 past Y=70,000 without death or respawn, resulting in an unrecoverable soft-lock.
